author: Notogoyslop
quote: This is nothing but male shaming, woke and leftist propaganda aimed at the younger gamers. On top of all that Rockstar had the nerves to the day before the game released when they knew everyone had pre-downloaded the game and could not get a refund. Then they tell everyone that the game will target 30 fps. Read that again, Target. Which is often even as low as 23 fps. This is absolutely not okay for a over 100$ game. And the game is filled with bugs and glitches and the fact that none of the so called game journalists mention this is pretty obvious. The characters are boring and have no personality. The voice acting is a joke compared to other GTA games and Red Dead Redemption 2. It is so obvious that the woke activists who calls themselves the devs on Rockstar copy pasted Red Dead Redemption 2's story line and gameplay and somehow made the worst game they could possible make. This is what happens when you take away the talent that made GTA famous in the first place. Do yourself a favor and play previous GTA games instead. This is nothing no one should spend their time doing.
